title: Record page after #35891: refresh the highlightFields / hideFields descriptions, Studio help and stale comments that still describe the removed strip
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found by the L1 review of PR #35938 (#35891 + #35849). Part of epic #35590 (record page redo).

## Gap
PR #35938 removes the key-field strip and the stage path from the record page, but several descriptions still talk about them:
1. The spec `highlightFields` describe text and its Studio help text.
2. The generated `record:details.hideFields` description.
3. Stale comments on `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`, on the semantic-zoo example object, and in the dogfood test.

## To do
Once #35938 merges, reword each one to describe what the record page does now. Regenerate whatever is generated from the changed source, and carry the locale strings for any changed help text.

## Acceptance
- No description, help text or comment says the record page draws a key-field strip or a stage path.
- The generated baselines and locale count pins stay green.

Reader: `domain:ui` / `packages/spec`.
